english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something becomes different or turns into something else.

exampleSentences.english: The weather is starting to change and get cold.
exampleSentences.jyutping: tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 bin3 dung3 laa3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something changes over time or is not constant.

exampleSentences.english: The price of this fruit will vary with the season.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢款水果嘅價錢會隨住季節變。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 fun2 seoi2 gwo2 ge3 gaa3 cin4 wui5 ceoi4 zyu6 gwai3 zit3 bin3

english.note: Use 變 when something becomes different, especially without emphasizing who deliberately changed it.

exampleSentences.english: The situation can alter very quickly.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 cing4 fong3 ho2 ji5 bin3 dak1 hou2 faai3

english.note: Use this for a change of state, with complements such as 變成 or 變壞 for becoming something or going bad.
Use this for something undergoing a change in appearance or character, often with 咗 or 緊.

exampleSentences.english: After the renovation, the room will transform and look much nicer.
exampleSentences.traditional: 裝修完之後，間房會變靚好多。
exampleSentences.jyutping: zong1 sau1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 gaan1 fong2 wui5 bin3 leng3 hou2 do1
